entry_warning: STRUCTURE_SCOPE: linked PDBs include wild-type 6NJ8 and engineered constructs 7MH2 (T4GALA) and 8RVJ (P3P4); use assemblies.variant_status before assigning structure-specific properties.
loading_info: Cargo: IMEF (iron-mineralizing encapsulin-associated firmicute; ferroxidase) + minor 2Fe-2S ferredoxin (Fdx); high-capacity iron storage (>23,000 Fe). Mechanism: cargo C-terminal TP.
curator_notes: Largest confirmed encapsulin in this set: T=4, 240 subunits, 42 nm, 9.6 MDa. Both 3- and 5-fold pores are negatively charged. Melting temperature reported as 86.6 °C.
